description: Land Acquisition -  Thalakiriyagama, Galewela D/S Division, Matale District - Amendment  to the Ex. Gazette No. 1986/4 of 26.09.2016 Baddegama D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels and servitudes for public purposes (railway project), including lot numbers, descriptions, extents, and claimant information. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes) and is specifically published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette.
